title: Outdoor Ecology, Pollen, Protected Climate, and Weather Response Workbook
purpose: Provide decision records for outdoor IPM ecology, pollen drift, greenhouse climate, high tunnels, and structured weather response.

sections.title: Pest and Beneficial Scouting Record
sections.decisionPrompt: Does pest trend and injury justify action after beneficial activity is considered?

sections.title: Pollen Drift Risk Record
sections.decisionPrompt: What combination of source strength, overlap, wind, and distance makes unwanted pollination plausible?

sections.title: Greenhouse Climate Control Record
sections.decisionPrompt: Which control is limiting moisture or heat removal under current crop load?

sections.title: High-Tunnel Performance Record
sections.decisionPrompt: Is the tunnel solving the intended constraint without creating a larger climate or disease problem?

sections.title: Weather Response and Recovery Record
sections.decisionPrompt: Did the response reduce risk, and what should change before the next event?

qualityRules: Use trend-based IPM records, not presence-only treatment decisions.
Keep pollen-risk observations spatially and temporally explicit.
Compare inside and outside protected-environment conditions.
Close weather events with recovery, CAPA, and release records.
